output.reason: A 6-year-old with reported fever of 103, a non-blanching purple rash on the legs and marked sleepiness raises immediate concern for meningococcal sepsis or bacterial meningitis requiring emergency assessment and IV treatment now.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. A fever with purple spots that don't fade when pressed, plus unusual sleepiness, can mean a rapidly worsening bloodstream infection that needs emergency hospital treatment immediately. Do not wait for a reply here, and do not wait to see if he improves. Stay with him; if he becomes unresponsive, has a seizure, or struggles to breathe, tell the dispatcher right away.
differential: Meningococcal sepsis / invasive bacterial infection with purpura
